# Kestro UI

> Beautiful React + Tailwind CSS components for AI agents: chat, reasoning, tool calls, approvals, plans, voice and Jarvis-style HUDs.

Install: `npm i kestro-ui`. With Tailwind CSS v4 add `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "kestro-ui/theme.css";` to your CSS. Without Tailwind: `import "kestro-ui/styles.css"`. Dark mode: add the `dark` class to an ancestor. All components are named exports of `kestro-ui`.

Fastest path: `<AgentChat messages={messages} status={status} onSend={(text) => …} />` renders a complete agent chat. Messages are `{ id, role, content }` or `{ id, role, parts }` where parts follow the Vercel AI SDK UIMessage format (text, reasoning, tool-<name>, source-url, file, data-<name>).

# Introduction

**Kestro UI** is an open-source React + Tailwind CSS component library for building interfaces for **AI agents**: chat assistants, research agents, customer-support bots, booking and shopping agents, operations workflows, voice assistants, multi-agent systems and Jarvis-style HUDs.

Agents need more than a chat box. They think, call tools, ask for permission, cite sources, run multi-step plans, hand off to humans and talk out loud. Kestro UI gives every one of those moments a polished, accessible component.

## Principles

- **Batteries included, never locked in.** `<AgentChat />` gives you a complete experience in one line. Every piece inside it (`Reasoning`, `ToolCall`, `ToolApproval`, `PromptInput`…) is exported so you can compose your own.
- **Backend-agnostic.** Messages use a simple `parts` format compatible with the Vercel AI SDK `useChat()`, and plain `{ role, content }` objects work too. Bring LangGraph, Mastra, OpenAI Agents, your own SSE, anything.
- **Human in the loop by default.** Approvals for payments, emails, bookings and deletions; structured questions; plans with live progress; hand-off to a person.
- **Zero heavy dependencies.** Streaming Markdown, syntax highlighting and citations are built in. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- **Smooth.** Spring and expo motion, smooth token streaming, and full respect for `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **AI-native docs.** Every page has a *Copy for AI* button, and the site ships `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` so coding assistants use the components correctly.

## What's inside

| Area | Components |
|---|---|
| Chat | `AgentChat`, `Thread`, `Message`, `MessageActions`, `Markdown`, `StreamingMarkdown`, `CodeBlock`, `TypingIndicator` |
| Input | `PromptInput`, `ModelSelector`, `Suggestions`, `EmptyState`, `Attachment` |
| Transparency | `Reasoning`, `ToolCall`, `Sources`, `InlineCitation` |
| Human in the loop | `ToolApproval`, `AgentQuestion`, `HandoffBanner` |
| Workflows | `TaskPlan`, `AgentHeader`, `UsageMeter`, `ActivityFeed`, `Artifact`, `ConversationList` |
| Multi-agent | `AgentAvatar`, `AgentRoster`, `AgentHandoff` |
| Voice | `VoicePanel`, `VoiceOrb`, `VoiceWave`, `useMicrophone`, `useAudioAnalyser` |
| HUD | `AgentCore`, `HudPanel`, `RadialGauge`, `HudStat`, `Sparkline`, `Waveform`, `CommandConsole`, `BootSequence`, `DataTicker` |
| Embed | `ChatWidget` |

Continue with **Installation** to add Kestro UI to your app.

---

# Installation

Kestro UI works with **React 18+** and is designed for **Tailwind CSS v4**, but it also ships a pre-compiled stylesheet for apps without Tailwind.

## 1. Install the package

```bash
npm install kestro-ui
# or
pnpm add kestro-ui
```

## 2. Add the styles

### Option A: Tailwind CSS v4 (recommended)

Import the theme after Tailwind in your main stylesheet. It registers the design tokens and tells Tailwind to scan Kestro's components for class names.

```css
/* app.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "kestro-ui/theme.css";
```

### Option B: no Tailwind

Import the pre-compiled CSS once, for example in your root layout:

```tsx
import "kestro-ui/styles.css";
```

## 3. Use a component

```tsx
import { AgentChat, type ChatMessage } from "kestro-ui";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function App() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  return (
    <div className="h-dvh">
      <AgentChat
        messages={messages}
        agent={{ name: "Atlas", description: "Your travel concierge" }}
        suggestions={["Plan a weekend in Lisbon", "Find a quiet hotel"]}
        onSend={(text) =>
          setMessages((m) => [...m, { id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: "user", content: text }])
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Dark mode

Kestro UI follows a `.dark` class (or `data-theme="dark"`) on any ancestor, the same convention as Tailwind and shadcn/ui:

```html
<html class="dark">
```

## Next.js

All components are client components and the package ships with a `"use client"` directive, so you can import them directly into Server Component pages.

## Requirements

- React 18 or 19
- Tailwind CSS v4 (Option A) or any setup (Option B)
- Modern evergreen browsers (uses `oklch()`, `color-mix()` and container queries)

---

# Connect your agent

Kestro UI only cares about two things: a list of **messages** and a **status**. Any backend that can produce those works.

## The message format

```ts
type ChatMessage = {
  id: string;
  role: "user" | "assistant" | "system";
  content?: string;          // shortcut for one text part
  parts?: ChatMessagePart[]; // rich content, rendered in order
  name?: string;             // agent name (multi-agent)
};
```

Supported parts (compatible with the Vercel AI SDK `UIMessage`):

| Part | Renders as |
|---|---|
| `{ type: "text", text, state? }` | Streaming Markdown with citations |
| `{ type: "reasoning", text, state? }` | `Reasoning` (collapsible thinking) |
| `{ type: "tool-<name>", state, input, output, errorText }` | `ToolCall` |
| `{ type: "tool-<name>", state: "approval-requested", approval: { id } }` | `ToolApproval` |
| `{ type: "source-url", url, title }` | `Sources` + inline `[1]` citations |
| `{ type: "file", url, filename, mediaType }` | `Attachment` |
| `{ type: "data-<name>", data }` | Your own UI via `renderData` |

Tool states map to statuses: `input-streaming` → pending, `input-available` → running, `output-available` → success, `output-error` → error, `output-denied` → denied.

**Status** is one of `"ready" | "submitted" | "streaming" | "error"`.

## Vercel AI SDK

```tsx
import { useChat } from "@ai-sdk/react";
import { AgentChat } from "kestro-ui";

export function Chat() {
  const { messages, status, sendMessage, stop } = useChat();
  return (
    <AgentChat
      messages={messages}
      status={status}
      onSend={(text) => sendMessage({ text })}
      onStop={stop}
    />
  );
}
```

## Any other backend (SSE, WebSocket, LangGraph…)

Keep messages in state and update the last assistant message as chunks arrive:

```tsx
const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
const [status, setStatus] = useState<ChatStatus>("ready");

async function send(text: string) {
  const id = crypto.randomUUID();
  let reply = "";
  setMessages((m) => [
    ...m,
    { id: `${id}-user`, role: "user", content: text },
    { id, role: "assistant", parts: [{ type: "text", text: "" }] },
  ]);
  setStatus("streaming");
  for await (const chunk of streamFromYourAgent(text)) {
    reply += chunk;
    const snapshot = reply;
    setMessages((m) => m.map((msg) => (msg.id === id ? { ...msg, parts: [{ type: "text", text: snapshot }] } : msg)));
  }
  setStatus("ready");
}
```

`StreamingMarkdown` (used inside `AgentChat`) smooths bursty chunks automatically, so the text flows even if your server sends large, irregular pieces.

## Generative UI

Render your own components for specific tools or data parts:

```tsx
<AgentChat
  messages={messages}
  renderTool={(part, { name }) =>
    name === "get_weather" && part.state === "output-available"
      ? <WeatherCard data={part.output} />
      : undefined
  }
  renderData={(part) => (part.type === "data-flights" ? <FlightList flights={part.data} /> : null)}
/>
```

Return `undefined` from `renderTool` to fall back to the default `ToolCall` card.

## Approvals

When a tool part arrives with `state: "approval-requested"`, `AgentChat` shows a `ToolApproval` card and calls `onToolApproval({ id, approved, part })` with the user's decision. Send that decision back to your agent runtime to continue or cancel.

---

# Theming

Every color, radius and shadow in Kestro UI is a CSS variable. Override them anywhere: globally, per page, or per component subtree.

## Accent color

```css
:root {
  --kui-accent: oklch(0.66 0.16 160); /* emerald */
}
```

Try the color dots in the top bar of this site: they change exactly one variable.

## All tokens

| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--kui-bg` | App background |
| `--kui-surface`, `--kui-surface-2`, `--kui-surface-3` | Cards and raised layers |
| `--kui-border`, `--kui-border-strong` | Hairlines and emphasized borders |
| `--kui-fg`, `--kui-fg-muted`, `--kui-fg-subtle` | Text hierarchy |
| `--kui-accent`, `--kui-accent-fg` | Brand color and text on it |
| `--kui-success`, `--kui-warning`, `--kui-danger`, `--kui-info` | Status colors |
| `--kui-user-bubble` | User message bubble |
| `--kui-code-*` | Code block and syntax colors |
| `--kui-radius` | Base corner radius (other radii derive from it) |
| `--kui-shadow`, `--kui-shadow-lg` | Elevation |

Light values live on `:root`; dark values on `.dark`, `[data-theme="dark"]` or `[data-kui-theme="dark"]`.

## Use the tokens in your own code

With Tailwind v4 the tokens become utilities, so your own UI matches the kit:

```tsx
<div className="rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-4 text-kui-fg-muted shadow-kui">
  …
</div>
```

## Motion

Kestro ships easing tokens you can reuse: `ease-kui-out` (expo out), `ease-kui-spring` (soft spring), `ease-kui-in-out`, and entrance animations `animate-kui-in`, `animate-kui-pop`, `animate-kui-fade` and `animate-kui-reveal`.

All animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Overriding a single component

Every component accepts `className`, and classes are merged with `tailwind-merge`, so your utilities always win:

```tsx
<ToolCall className="rounded-none border-dashed" name="search" status="running" />
```

---

# Using with AI assistants

Kestro UI is designed to be easy for **AI coding assistants** (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, v0…) to use correctly.

## llms.txt

This site publishes machine-readable docs following the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention:

- **[llms.txt](./llms.txt)**: a short index of every component with one-line descriptions and links.
- **[llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt)**: the complete documentation in one file: guides, every example's source code, and full prop tables generated from the TypeScript types.

Point your assistant at it:

```text
Build this with the Kestro UI component library.
Docs: https://himasrafeek.github.io/kestro-ui/llms-full.txt
```

## AGENTS.md in the package

The npm package ships `AGENTS.md` and `llms-full.txt` next to the code, so assistants that read `node_modules` can discover the API offline:

```text
node_modules/kestro-ui/AGENTS.md
node_modules/kestro-ui/llms-full.txt
```

## Copy for AI

Every component page has a **Copy for AI** button. It copies a Markdown version of the page (description, import, example code and props table) that you can paste straight into a chat.

## Tips for prompting

- Ask for *Kestro UI components* and name the ones you want (`AgentChat`, `ToolApproval`, `TaskPlan`…).
- For full chat UIs, ask the assistant to use `<AgentChat>` with the `ChatMessage` parts format.
- For custom tool UIs, ask for `renderTool` / `renderData` instead of re-implementing message rendering.
- Remind it to add `@import "kestro-ui/theme.css";` after `@import "tailwindcss";`.

## Fully typed

Every prop is typed and documented with JSDoc, so editors and assistants get autocomplete and inline docs.

---

# AgentChat

> Category: Chat · Package: `kestro-ui`

A complete, batteries-included agent chat: thread, messages, reasoning, tools, approvals, sources, empty state, follow-ups and the prompt input. One component, works with any backend.

## Import

```tsx
import { AgentChat } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: agent-chat

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AgentChat, type ChatMessage, type ChatStatus } from "kestro-ui";
import { Hotel, Plane, Utensils } from "lucide-react";

const REPLY =
  "Here's a relaxed **3-day Lisbon** plan:\n\n" +
  "1. **Day 1:** Alfama walk, Castelo de São Jorge, sunset at Miradouro da Graça\n" +
  "2. **Day 2:** Belém Tower, pastéis de nata, MAAT museum\n" +
  "3. **Day 3:** Day trip to Sintra's Pena Palace\n\n" +
  "Want me to look for hotels near Baixa?";

export default function Example() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ChatStatus>("ready");
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);

  const stop = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    window.clearInterval(timer.current);
    setStatus("ready");
  };

  const send = (text: string) => {
    const id = String(Date.now());
    setMessages((m) => [...m, { id: `${id}-u`, role: "user", content: text }]);
    setStatus("submitted");

    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setStatus("streaming");
      setMessages((m) => [...m, { id, role: "assistant", parts: [{ type: "text", text: "", state: "streaming" }] }]);
      let i = 0;
      timer.current = window.setInterval(() => {
        i += 6;
        const done = i >= REPLY.length;
        setMessages((m) =>
          m.map((msg) =>
            msg.id === id
              ? { ...msg, parts: [{ type: "text", text: REPLY.slice(0, i), state: done ? "done" : "streaming" }] }
              : msg,
          ),
        );
        if (done) stop();
      }, 30);
    }, 700);
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-[520px] w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-kui border border-kui-border">
      <AgentChat
        messages={messages}
        status={status}
        onSend={send}
        onStop={stop}
        agent={{ name: "Atlas", description: "Your travel concierge for flights, stays and itineraries." }}
        suggestions={[
          { label: "Plan a weekend in Lisbon", icon: <Plane /> },
          { label: "Find a hotel near the beach", icon: <Hotel /> },
          { label: "Best tapas in Barcelona", icon: <Utensils /> },
        ]}
        header
        compact
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <AgentChat />

Batteries-included chat surface: thread, messages, reasoning, tools,
approvals, sources, empty state, follow-ups and the prompt input.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `messages` **(required)** | `ChatMessage[]` | — |  |
| `status` | `"error" \| "streaming" \| "ready" \| "submitted"` | `"ready"` |  |
| `onSend` | `((text: string, submission: PromptSubmission) => void)` | — |  |
| `onStop` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `onRegenerate` | `((messageId: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `onFeedback` | `((messageId: string, value: Feedback) => void)` | — |  |
| `agent` | `AgentInfo` | — |  |
| `header` | `ReactNode` | — | `true` renders a default header from `agent`; or pass your own node. |
| `welcome` | `{ title?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; }` | — | Empty-state title/description. |
| `suggestions` | `Suggestion[]` | — | Starter prompts shown in the empty state. |
| `followUps` | `Suggestion[]` | — | Follow-up chips shown above the input after the last answer. |
| `models` | `ModelOption[]` | — |  |
| `model` | `string` | — |  |
| `onModelChange` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — |  |
| `allowAttachments` | `false \| true` | `true` |  |
| `onVoice` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `toolbar` | `ReactNode` | — | Extra controls in the prompt toolbar. |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | — | Error message shown at the end of the thread. |
| `onRetry` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `compact` | `false \| true` | `false` | Tighter spacing for widgets & side panels. |
| `autoFocus` | `false \| true` | — | Focus the input on mount. Defaults to `true` unless `compact`. |
| `variant` | `"bubble" \| "flat"` | `"bubble"` | Message layout. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `renderCode` | `((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)` | — |  |
| `renderTool` | `((part: ToolPart, ctx: { name: string; status: ToolStatus; }) => ReactNode)` | — | Return a node to custom-render a tool (generative UI); return undefined for the default card. |
| `renderData` | `((part: DataPart) => ReactNode)` | — | Render custom `data-*` parts. |
| `onToolApproval` | `((decision: { id: string; approved: boolean; part: ToolPart; }) => void)` | — |  |
| `toolTitles` | `Record<string, string>` | — | Friendly titles per tool name, e.g. { web_search: "Searching the web" } |

---

# Message

> Category: Chat · Package: `kestro-ui`

A single chat message for user, assistant or system roles, with avatar, name, timestamp and hover actions (copy, feedback, regenerate).

## Import

```tsx
import { Message, MessageActions } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: message

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Markdown, Message, MessageActions, type Feedback } from "kestro-ui";

const ANSWER =
  "Your order **#48213** shipped this morning via UPS and should arrive **Thursday, Nov 21**. " +
  "I've emailed you the tracking link.";

export default function Example() {
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<Feedback>(null);
  const [regenerations, setRegenerations] = useState(0);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-6">
      <Message from="system">Conversation started · Today 9:41 AM</Message>

      <Message from="user" timestamp="9:41 AM">
        Where is my order? It's been a few days.
      </Message>

      <Message
        from="assistant"
        name="Nova · Support"
        avatar={{ name: "Nova", state: "online" }}
        timestamp="9:41 AM"
        actions={
          <MessageActions
            copyText={ANSWER}
            feedback={feedback}
            onFeedback={setFeedback}
            onRegenerate={() => setRegenerations((n) => n + 1)}
            alwaysVisible
          />
        }
      >
        <Markdown>{ANSWER}</Markdown>
      </Message>

      <p className="text-center text-xs text-kui-fg-subtle">
        Feedback: {feedback ?? "none"} · Regenerated {regenerations}×
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Message />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` **(required)** | `"user" \| "assistant" \| "system"` | — |  |
| `name` | `ReactNode` | — | Display name (shown above assistant messages). |
| `avatar` | `ReactNode \| AgentAvatarProps` | — | Avatar node, avatar props, or `false` to hide. |
| `timestamp` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | — | Rendered under the message (e.g. <MessageActions/>). |
| `variant` | `"bubble" \| "flat"` | `"bubble"` | "bubble": user messages in a bubble on the right (default) "flat":   everything left-aligned with avatars (document style) |

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

### <MessageActions />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `copyText` | `string` | — | Text copied by the copy button. Omit to hide it. |
| `onRegenerate` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `onEdit` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `feedback` | `"up" \| "down"` | — |  |
| `onFeedback` | `((value: Feedback) => void)` | — |  |
| `alwaysVisible` | `false \| true` | `false` | Keep visible instead of revealing on hover. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# Thread

> Category: Chat · Package: `kestro-ui`

Scrollable message list that sticks to the bottom while content streams in, with a floating scroll-to-bottom button.

## Import

```tsx
import { Thread } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: thread

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Message, Thread } from "kestro-ui";
import { Plus } from "lucide-react";

type Line = { id: number; from: "user" | "assistant"; text: string };

const script = [
  "Is the 2 TB NVMe drive compatible with my laptop?",
  "Yes! Your model has an M.2 2280 slot that supports PCIe 4.0, so it will work at full speed.",
  "Great. Does it come with a heatsink?",
  "It doesn't, but your laptop has a built-in thermal pad over the slot, so you won't need one.",
  "Can it arrive by Friday?",
  "Order in the next 3 hours and choose Express — it arrives Thursday.",
];

export default function Example() {
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<Line[]>(
    script.slice(0, 4).map((text, i) => ({ id: i, from: i % 2 ? "assistant" : "user", text })),
  );

  const add = () =>
    setLines((ls) => {
      const i = ls.length;
      return [...ls, { id: i, from: i % 2 ? "assistant" : "user", text: script[i % script.length] }];
    });

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-3">
      <div className="flex h-[420px] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-bg">
        <Thread contentClassName="gap-5 py-5">
          {lines.map((l) => (
            <Message key={l.id} from={l.from} name={l.from === "assistant" ? "Shopper" : undefined}>
              {l.text}
            </Message>
          ))}
        </Thread>
      </div>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={add}>
        <Plus /> Add message
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Thread />

Scrollable message list that sticks to the bottom while content streams.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — | Classes for the scroll container. |
| `contentClassName` | `string` | — | Classes for the centered content column. |
| `hideScrollButton` | `false \| true` | — | Hide the floating "scroll to bottom" button. |

---

# Markdown

> Category: Chat · Package: `kestro-ui`

Zero-dependency, safe Markdown renderer for LLM output: tables, task lists, code, citations. StreamingMarkdown adds a smooth, frame-paced reveal for bursty token streams.

## Import

```tsx
import { Markdown, StreamingMarkdown } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: markdown

```tsx
import { Markdown, type Source } from "kestro-ui";

const sources: Source[] = [
  { url: "https://example.com/energy-report-2026", title: "Global Energy Outlook 2026", snippet: "Solar capacity grew 32% year over year." },
  { url: "https://example.com/battery-costs", title: "Battery pack prices hit record low", snippet: "Average pack prices fell below $90/kWh." },
];

const content = `## Home solar: is it worth it?

Short answer: **usually yes**, especially if you plan to stay *5+ years*. Panel installs grew fast last year [1], and storage keeps getting cheaper [2].

### What to check first
- Roof orientation and shade
- Your average monthly bill
- Local incentives and net metering

### Your checklist
- [x] Pull last 12 months of utility bills
- [x] Get a satellite roof estimate
- [ ] Request 3 installer quotes

| System | Upfront cost | Payback |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| 6 kW panels | $14,800 | 7.5 yrs |
| 6 kW + battery | $24,300 | 10.2 yrs |

Estimate savings with \`monthly_bill * 0.7\` as a rough rule of thumb:

\`\`\`python
def payback_years(cost: float, monthly_savings: float) -> float:
    return round(cost / (monthly_savings * 12), 1)

print(payback_years(14_800, 165))  # 7.5
\`\`\`

> **Tip:** quotes vary a lot. The cheapest per-watt price isn't always the best warranty.`;

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl">
      <Markdown sources={sources}>{content}</Markdown>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: streaming-markdown

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button, StreamingMarkdown } from "kestro-ui";
import { RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

const FULL = `### Weeknight lemon garlic pasta

Ready in **20 minutes**, serves 2.

1. Boil 200 g spaghetti in well-salted water.
2. Meanwhile, sizzle 3 sliced garlic cloves in olive oil until *just* golden.
3. Toss the pasta with the garlic, zest of 1 lemon, a splash of pasta water and parmesan.

> Finish with black pepper and chopped parsley. A handful of spinach works great too.`;

export default function Example() {
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [streaming, setStreaming] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);

  const replay = () => {
    window.clearInterval(timer.current);
    setText("");
    setStreaming(true);
    let i = 0;
    timer.current = window.setInterval(() => {
      i += 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 28);
      setText(FULL.slice(0, i));
      if (i >= FULL.length) {
        window.clearInterval(timer.current);
        setStreaming(false);
      }
    }, 120);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    replay();
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer.current);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-4">
      <div className="min-h-64 rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-5">
        <StreamingMarkdown streaming={streaming}>{text}</StreamingMarkdown>
      </div>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={replay}>
        <RotateCcw /> Replay
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Markdown />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` **(required)** | `string` | — |  |
| `streaming` | `false \| true` | `false` | Show a blinking caret at the end of the content. |
| `sources` | `Source[]` | — | Sources used to resolve `[1]`-style inline citations. |
| `renderCode` | `((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)` | — | Override code block rendering (e.g. plug in Shiki). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <StreamingMarkdown />

Markdown + smooth token reveal + caret. Use this for live LLM output.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `streaming` | `false \| true` | `false` | True while tokens are still arriving. |
| `smooth` | `boolean \| SmoothTextOptions` | `true` | Smooth out bursty chunks with a frame-paced reveal. Default true. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `children` **(required)** | `string` | — |  |
| `sources` | `Source[]` | — | Sources used to resolve `[1]`-style inline citations. |
| `renderCode` | `((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)` | — | Override code block rendering (e.g. plug in Shiki). |

# CodeBlock

> Category: Chat · Package: `kestro-ui`

Syntax-highlighted code with copy button, filename, line numbers and a streaming caret. Built-in tiny highlighter, no dependencies.

## Import

```tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: code-block

```tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "kestro-ui";

const handler = `import { streamText } from "ai";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { messages } = await req.json();
  const result = streamText({
    model: "anthropic/claude-sonnet",
    system: "You are a friendly travel concierge.",
    messages,
  });
  return result.toUIMessageStreamResponse();
}`;

const query = `SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY revenue DESC;`;

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl space-y-4">
      <CodeBlock code={handler} language="ts" filename="app/api/chat/route.ts" showLineNumbers />
      <CodeBlock code={query} language="sql" hideHeader />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <CodeBlock />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` **(required)** | `string` | — |  |
| `language` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `filename` | `string` | — | Shown in the header instead of the language. |
| `showLineNumbers` | `false \| true` | `false` |  |
| `hideHeader` | `false \| true` | `false` | Hide the header bar (copy button floats on hover instead). |
| `maxHeight` | `string \| number` | — | Max height before scrolling, e.g. 320 or "20rem". |
| `streaming` | `false \| true` | — | Show a blinking caret at the end (while streaming). |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | — | Extra actions rendered in the header. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# PromptInput

> Category: Input · Package: `kestro-ui`

Auto-growing composer with attachments (button, drag & drop, paste), stop button while streaming, voice button and toolbar slots.

## Import

```tsx
import { PromptInput } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: prompt-input

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ModelSelector, PromptInput, type ChatStatus } from "kestro-ui";
import { Brain, Sparkles, Zap } from "lucide-react";

const models = [
  { id: "auto", name: "Auto", icon: <Sparkles />, description: "Picks the best model per request" },
  { id: "fast", name: "Fast", icon: <Zap />, description: "Quick answers for everyday tasks", badge: "Fast" },
  { id: "deep", name: "Deep think", icon: <Brain />, description: "Multi-step reasoning", badge: "Reasoning" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ChatStatus>("ready");
  const [model, setModel] = useState("auto");
  const [listening, setListening] = useState(false);
  const [last, setLast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);

  const stop = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    setStatus("ready");
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-3">
      <PromptInput
        placeholder="Ask about your spending, budgets or bills…"
        status={status}
        onStop={stop}
        onSubmit={({ text }) => {
          setLast(text);
          setStatus("streaming");
          timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setStatus("ready"), 2000);
        }}
        onVoice={() => setListening((v) => !v)}
        voiceActive={listening}
        toolbar={<ModelSelector models={models} value={model} onValueChange={setModel} />}
      />
      {last ? (
        <p className="text-center text-xs text-kui-fg-subtle">
          Sent with <span className="text-kui-fg-muted">{model}</span>: “{last}”
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <PromptInput />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | — |  |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `onValueChange` | `((value: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `onSubmit` | `((message: PromptSubmission) => void)` | — |  |
| `status` | `"error" \| "streaming" \| "ready" \| "submitted"` | `"ready"` | "streaming"/"submitted" turns the send button into a stop button. |
| `onStop` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Ask anything…"` |  |
| `disabled` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `autoFocus` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `maxRows` | `number` | `8` |  |
| `allowAttachments` | `false \| true` | `true` | Enable file attachments (button, drag & drop, paste). |
| `accept` | `string` | — |  |
| `attachments` | `AttachmentData[]` | — | Controlled attachments. If omitted, attachments are managed internally. |
| `onAttach` | `((files: File[]) => void)` | — |  |
| `onRemoveAttachment` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `references` | `PromptReference[]` | — | Context chips shown above the input (e.g. a referenced image). |
| `onRemoveReference` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `onVoice` | `(() => void)` | — | Show a microphone button. |
| `voiceActive` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `toolbar` | `ReactNode` | — | Extra controls on the left of the toolbar (e.g. <ModelSelector/>). |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | — | Extra controls on the right of the toolbar, before send. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` | — | Footer hint. `false` hides it. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

---

```tsx
const models: ModelOption[] = [
  { id: "auto", name: "Auto", icon: <Sparkles />, description: "Routes each request to the best model" },
  { id: "flash", name: "Flash", icon: <Zap />, description: "Fastest replies, lowest cost", badge: "Fast" },
  { id: "reason", name: "Reasoner", icon: <Brain />, description: "Thinks step by step before answering", badge: "Reasoning" },
  { id: "research", name: "Deep research", icon: <Search />, description: "Reads dozens of sources for you", badge: "New" },
  { id: "web", name: "Web agent", icon: <Globe />, description: "Browses sites on your behalf", disabled: true },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState("auto");

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-xl min-h-96 flex-col items-center gap-3">
```

# Attachment

> Category: Input · Package: `kestro-ui`

File chips with type-aware icons, image previews, upload progress and errors.

## Import

```tsx
import { Attachment, AttachmentList } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: attachment

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AttachmentList, type AttachmentData } from "kestro-ui";

const initial: AttachmentData[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "Q3-expense-report.pdf", type: "application/pdf", size: 482_133 },
  { id: "2", name: "transactions-october.csv", size: 18_420 },
  { id: "3", name: "receipt-photo.jpg", type: "image/jpeg", size: 2_310_000 },
  { id: "4", name: "invoice-2291.pdf", size: 96_000, progress: 0 },
  { id: "5", name: "bank-statement.zip", size: 64_000_000, error: "File too large (max 25 MB)" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState(initial);

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = window.setInterval(() => {
      setFiles((fs) =>
        fs.map((f) => (f.progress !== undefined && f.progress < 100 ? { ...f, progress: Math.min(100, f.progress + 7) } : f)),
      );
    }, 250);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-3">
      <AttachmentList attachments={files} onRemove={(id) => setFiles((fs) => fs.filter((f) => f.id !== id))} />
      {files.length < initial.length ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setFiles(initial)} className="text-xs font-medium text-kui-accent hover:underline">
          Reset files
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Attachment />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachment` **(required)** | `AttachmentData` | — |  |
| `onRemove` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <AttachmentList />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attachments` **(required)** | `AttachmentData[]` | — |  |
| `onRemove` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# Reasoning

> Category: Agent transparency · Package: `kestro-ui`

Collapsible thinking block with live shimmer, last-line preview and automatic duration.

## Import

```tsx
import { Reasoning } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: reasoning

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Reasoning } from "kestro-ui";

const thoughts = `The user wants to fly **NYC → Tokyo** in late March under $900.

- Direct flights from JFK start around $1,150, too expensive.
- One-stop via Seoul on Mar 24 is $812 with a 2h layover.
- Checking whether Haneda or Narita is closer to their hotel in Shibuya…`;

export default function Example() {
  const [streaming, setStreaming] = useState(true);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-4">
      <Reasoning content={thoughts} streaming={streaming} />
      <Button variant="outline" size="xs" onClick={() => setStreaming((s) => !s)}>
        {streaming ? "Finish thinking" : "Resume thinking"}
      </Button>

      <Reasoning
        duration={14}
        content="Compared 3 refund policies. The order is within the 30-day window and unopened, so a full refund applies."
      />

      <Reasoning
        variant="inline"
        duration={6}
        defaultOpen
        content="Converted 2 cups of flour to **250 g** and scaled the recipe from 4 to 6 servings."
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Reasoning />

| `duration` | `number` | — | Seconds spent thinking. Measured automatically if omitted. |
| `summary` | `ReactNode` | — | Optional one-line summary shown under the title. |
| `variant` | `"card" \| "inline"` | `"card"` | "card" (bordered) or "inline" (minimal, flows with the message). |
| `open` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `false \| true` | `false` |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `((open: boolean) => void)` | — |  |

| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# ToolCall

> Category: Agent transparency · Package: `kestro-ui`

Shows a tool invocation with arguments, result, status and duration. Pass children to render custom results (generative UI).

## Import

```tsx
import { ToolCall, ToolCallGroup, ToolStatusBadge } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: tool-call

```tsx
import { ToolCall } from "kestro-ui";

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-2">
      <ToolCall name="check_inventory" status="pending" input={{ sku: "SHOE-AIR-42" }} />
      <ToolCall name="web_search" title="Searching the web" status="running" input={{ query: "best ramen in Osaka" }} />
      <ToolCall
        name="get_order_status"
        status="success"
        input={{ order_id: "48213" }}
        output={{ status: "shipped", carrier: "UPS", eta: "2026-11-21" }}
        durationMs={840}
        defaultOpen
      />
      <ToolCall
        name="charge_card"
        status="error"
        input={{ amount: 129.0, currency: "USD" }}
        error="Card declined: insufficient funds."
        onRetry={() => console.log("retry")}
        durationMs={1200}
      />
      <ToolCall name="send_email" status="denied" input={{ to: "team@example.com", subject: "Q3 numbers" }} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: tool-call-custom

```tsx
import { ToolCall, ToolCallGroup } from "kestro-ui";
import { CloudRain, CloudSun, Sun } from "lucide-react";

const forecast = [
  { day: "Fri", icon: <Sun />, high: 24, low: 16 },
  { day: "Sat", icon: <CloudSun />, high: 21, low: 15 },
  { day: "Sun", icon: <CloudRain />, high: 18, low: 13 },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl">
      <ToolCallGroup>
        <ToolCall name="geocode" title="Finding location" input={{ place: "Lisbon, Portugal" }} durationMs={210} />
        <ToolCall name="get_weather" title="Weekend forecast" input={{ city: "Lisbon", days: 3 }} durationMs={530} defaultOpen>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {forecast.map((d) => (
              <div
                key={d.day}
                className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 rounded-kui-sm border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface-2 p-3 [&_svg]:size-6 [&_svg]:text-kui-accent"
              >
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-kui-fg-muted">{d.day}</span>
                {d.icon}
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-kui-fg tabular-nums">
                  {d.high}° <span className="font-normal text-kui-fg-subtle">{d.low}°</span>
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </ToolCall>
      </ToolCallGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <ToolCall />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | `string` | — | Tool identifier, e.g. "web_search". |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Friendly title shown instead of the raw name (e.g. "Searching the web"). |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `status` | `"success" \| "error" \| "pending" \| "running" \| "denied"` | `"success"` |  |
| `input` | `unknown` | — |  |
| `output` | `unknown` | — |  |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `durationMs` | `number` | — | Duration in milliseconds. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom output renderer — overrides the default JSON/text output view. |
| `open` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `false \| true` | `false` |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `((open: boolean) => void)` | — |  |
| `onRetry` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <ToolCallGroup />

Stack of tool calls with a subtle connecting header, e.g. "Used 3 tools".

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <ToolStatusBadge />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

# ToolCallRow

> Category: Agent transparency · Package: `kestro-ui`

Compact, single-line tool status for dense lists and dashboards, with progress, duration and retry.

```tsx
  useEffect(() => {

  }, []);

    <div className="w-full max-w-xl rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface px-4">
      <ToolCallRow name="search_flights" icon={<Search />} status="running" progress={progress} />
      <ToolCallRow name="check_fare_rules" icon={<FileText />} status="success" durationMs={218} />
      <ToolCallRow name="book_flight" icon={<CalendarDays />} status="waiting" />

    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <ToolCallRow />

Compact, single-line tool status — for dense lists and dashboards.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | `string` | — |  |
| `status` **(required)** | `"success" \| "waiting" \| "error" \| "pending" \| "running" \| "denied"` | — |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `progress` | `number` | — | 0–100 shows a progress bar while running. |
| `durationMs` | `number` | — |  |
| `detail` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `onRetry` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# Sources

> Category: Agent transparency · Package: `kestro-ui`

Citations: collapsible source list, source cards, chips and inline numbered citations with hover previews.


## Example: sources

```tsx
import { InlineCitation, SourceCard, SourceChip, Sources, type Source } from "kestro-ui";

const sources: Source[] = [
  { url: "https://example.com/health/coffee-study", title: "Coffee and longevity: a 10-year cohort study", snippet: "Moderate intake of 2–3 cups a day was linked to lower mortality." },
  { url: "https://news.example.org/caffeine-sleep", title: "How late is too late for caffeine?", snippet: "Caffeine's half-life averages around 5 hours in healthy adults." },
  { url: "https://example.net/nutrition/guidelines", title: "Dietary guidelines 2025–2030", snippet: "Up to 400 mg of caffeine per day is considered safe for most adults." },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-5">
      <p className="text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-kui-fg">
        Two to three cups of coffee a day is linked to a longer life
        <InlineCitation index={1} source={sources[0]} />, but try to stop by early afternoon since caffeine lingers for
        hours
        <InlineCitation index={2} source={sources[1]} />.
      </p>

      <Sources sources={sources} defaultOpen />

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <SourceChip source={sources[2]} />
        <SourceChip source={sources[0]} index={1} />
      </div>

      <SourceCard source={sources[2]} index={3} />

  );
}
```

# ToolApproval

> Category: Human in the loop · Package: `kestro-ui`

Ask the user before the agent acts: payments, emails, bookings, deletions, shell commands. Supports details, previews, risk levels and 'remember' choice.

## Import

```tsx
import { ToolApproval } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: tool-approval

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, ToolApproval, type ApprovalStatus } from "kestro-ui";
import { Plane, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

export default function Example() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ApprovalStatus>("pending");

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-3">
      <ToolApproval
        icon={<Plane />}
        title="Book this flight for $412?"
        description="Atlas found a nonstop that matches your preferences and will charge your saved card."
        details={[
          { label: "Flight", value: "TAP 202 · JFK → LIS" },
          { label: "Departs", value: "Fri, Dec 12 · 7:45 PM" },
          { label: "Seat", value: "14A (window)" },
          { label: "Payment", value: "Visa •••• 4242" },
          { label: "Total", value: "$412.60" },
        ]}
        status={status}
        approveLabel="Book for $412.60"
        onApprove={() => setStatus("approved")}
        onDeny={() => setStatus("denied")}
      />
      {status !== "pending" ? (
        <Button variant="ghost" size="xs" onClick={() => setStatus("pending")}>
          <RotateCcw /> Reset
        </Button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example: tool-approval-command

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { ToolApproval, type ApprovalStatus } from "kestro-ui";
import { Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

export default function Example() {
  const [cleanup, setCleanup] = useState<ApprovalStatus>("pending");
  const [shell, setShell] = useState<ApprovalStatus>("pending");

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-4">
      <ToolApproval
        risk="high"
        icon={<Trash2 />}
        title="Delete 1,204 CRM records?"
        description="These contacts haven't been active in 2 years. This can't be undone."
        details={[
          { label: "Object", value: "Contacts" },
          { label: "Filter", value: "last_activity < 2024-11-01" },
          { label: "Records", value: "1,204" },
        ]}
        rememberLabel={false}
        approveLabel="Delete records"
        status={cleanup}
        onApprove={() => setCleanup("approved")}
        onDeny={() => setCleanup("denied")}
      />

      <ToolApproval
        risk="high"
        title="Run shell command?"
        description="The ops agent wants to restart the payments service on production."
        command="kubectl rollout restart deployment/payments -n prod"
        status={shell}
        onApprove={() => setShell("approved")}
        onDeny={() => setShell("denied")}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <ToolApproval />

Human-in-the-loop confirmation for any agent action.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — | e.g. "Send this email to 3 recipients?", "Book flight for $412?", "Run shell command?" |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `risk` | `"low" \| "medium" \| "high"` | `"medium"` |  |
| `details` | `ApprovalDetail[]` | — | Key/value rows describing exactly what will happen (amount, recipient, date…). |
| `command` | `string` | — | Optional command / code preview (rendered as a code block). |
| `commandLanguage` | `string` | `"bash"` |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Any custom preview (email draft, diff, product card…). |
| `status` | `"pending" \| "denied" \| "approved"` | `"pending"` |  |
| `onApprove` | `((opts: { remember: boolean; }) => void)` | — |  |
| `onDeny` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `rememberLabel` | `ReactNode` | `"Don't ask again for this action"` | Label for the "remember" checkbox. Pass `false` to hide it. |
| `approveLabel` | `ReactNode` | `"Approve"` |  |
| `denyLabel` | `ReactNode` | `"Deny"` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# AgentQuestion

> Category: Human in the loop · Package: `kestro-ui`

The agent asks the user a structured question: single or multiple choice, with optional free text.

## Import

```tsx
import { AgentQuestion } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: agent-question

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { AgentQuestion } from "kestro-ui";
import { Building2, House, Tent } from "lucide-react";

type Answer = { optionIds: string[]; text?: string };

export default function Example() {
  const [stay, setStay] = useState<Answer | null>(null);
  const [diet, setDiet] = useState<Answer | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-4">
      <AgentQuestion
        question="Where would you like to stay in Kyoto?"
        description="I'll only show options that fit your $180/night budget."
        options={[
          { id: "hotel", label: "Hotel", description: "Central, near Kyoto Station", icon: <Building2 /> },
          { id: "ryokan", label: "Ryokan", description: "Traditional inn with onsen", icon: <House /> },
          { id: "glamping", label: "Glamping", description: "Forest stay in Arashiyama", icon: <Tent /> },
        ]}
        answered={!!stay}
        onSubmit={setStay}
      />

      <AgentQuestion
        question="Any dietary preferences for the meal plan?"
        multiple
        allowCustom
        customPlaceholder="Anything else? e.g. no cilantro"
        options={[
          { id: "veg", label: "Vegetarian" },
          { id: "gf", label: "Gluten-free" },
          { id: "dairy", label: "Dairy-free" },
          { id: "lowcarb", label: "Low carb" },
        ]}
        answered={!!diet}
        onSubmit={setDiet}
        onSkip={() => setDiet({ optionIds: [] })}
      />

      <pre className="rounded-kui-sm bg-kui-surface-2 p-3 text-xs text-kui-fg-muted">
        {JSON.stringify({ stay, diet }, null, 2)}
      </pre>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <AgentQuestion />

The agent asks the user a structured question (choice or free text).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `options` | `QuestionOption[]` | `[]` |  |
| `multiple` | `false \| true` | `false` | Allow selecting several options. |
| `allowCustom` | `false \| true` | `false` | Show a free-text field ("Other…"). |
| `customPlaceholder` | `string` | `"Type your answer…"` |  |
| `submitLabel` | `ReactNode` | `"Continue"` |  |
| `answered` | `false \| true` | `false` | Once answered the card locks and shows the answer. |
| `onSubmit` | `((answer: { optionIds: string[]; text?: string \| undefined; }) => void)` | — |  |
| `onSkip` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# HandoffBanner

# TaskCreator

```tsx
        agents={[
```

# TaskBoard

> Category: Tasks · Package: `kestro-ui`

Kanban board of agent tasks — Queued, Running, Needs you, Done — with drag and drop and live progress.

## Import

```tsx
import { TaskBoard, TaskCard } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: task-board

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { TaskBoard, type AgentTask } from "kestro-ui";

const initial: AgentTask[] = [
  { id: "1", title: "Chase overdue invoices", status: "queued", agent: { name: "Ledger" }, priority: "high", tags: ["finance"], schedule: "Today 14:00" },
  { id: "2", title: "Weekly competitor pricing", status: "running", agent: { name: "Scout" }, progress: 35, steps: { done: 2, total: 5 }, tags: ["research"] },
  { id: "3", title: "Refund order #4821", status: "needs-input", agent: { name: "Support" }, description: "Approve a $249 refund to the original card.", priority: "urgent" },
  { id: "4", title: "Summarize Q3 board notes", status: "done", agent: { name: "Docs" }, updated: "12m ago", tags: ["docs"] },
  { id: "5", title: "Rebook Lisbon flight", status: "running", agent: { name: "Atlas" }, progress: 70, steps: { done: 4, total: 6 }, tags: ["travel"] },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(initial);

  // Running tasks make progress on their own
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setTasks((list) =>
        list.map((t) => {
          if (t.status !== "running") return t;
          const progress = Math.min(100, (t.progress ?? 0) + 7);
          return progress >= 100 ? { ...t, status: "done", progress, updated: "just now" } : { ...t, progress };
        }),
      );
    }, 1200);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-kui-fg-muted">Drag cards between columns.</p>
      <TaskBoard
        tasks={tasks}
        onMove={(id, status) => setTasks((list) => list.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, status, progress: status === "running" ? (t.progress ?? 0) : t.progress } : t)))}
        onAdd={(status) => setTasks((list) => [...list, { id: String(Date.now()), title: "New task", status, agent: { name: "Scout" } }])}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <TaskBoard />

Kanban board of agent tasks with drag-and-drop between columns.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tasks` **(required)** | `AgentTask[]` | — |  |
| `columns` | `TaskColumn[]` | `defaultTaskColumns` |  |
| `onMove` | `((taskId: string, status: TaskStatus) => void)` | — | Called when a task is dragged to another column. |
| `onOpen` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `onAdd` | `((status: TaskStatus) => void)` | — | Shows a "+" button per column. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <TaskCard />

Compact card for one agent task: status, agent, progress, schedule, tags.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` **(required)** | `AgentTask` | — |  |
| `onOpen` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | — | Extra controls, rendered in the footer. |
| `draggable` | `false \| true` | — | Enable HTML5 drag (used by TaskBoard). |
| `onDragStart` | `((e: DragEvent<Element>, id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `selected` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# TaskList

> Category: Tasks · Package: `kestro-ui`

Dense table of agent tasks with status, agent, progress, schedule and row actions.

## Import

```tsx
import { TaskList, TaskStatusBadge } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: task-list

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { IconButton, TaskList, type AgentTask } from "kestro-ui";
import { Pause, Play } from "lucide-react";

const initial: AgentTask[] = [
  { id: "1", title: "Morning inbox digest", status: "scheduled", agent: { name: "Inbox" }, schedule: "Every weekday · 08:00", priority: "normal" },
  { id: "2", title: "Monitor flight prices LHR → LIS", status: "running", agent: { name: "Atlas" }, progress: 62, schedule: "Every hour" },
  { id: "3", title: "Reconcile Stripe payouts", status: "failed", agent: { name: "Ledger" }, description: "Bank API returned 401 — reconnect the account.", priority: "high" },
  { id: "4", title: "Draft newsletter", status: "done", agent: { name: "Writer" }, updated: "Yesterday" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(initial);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string>();
  const toggle = (id: string) =>
    setTasks((list) => list.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, status: t.status === "running" ? "queued" : "running", progress: t.progress ?? 0 } : t)));

  return (
    <TaskList
      className="max-w-3xl"
      tasks={tasks}
      selectedId={selected}
      onOpen={setSelected}
      renderActions={(t) => (
        <IconButton label={t.status === "running" ? "Pause" : "Run now"} size="xs" onClick={() => toggle(t.id)}>
          {t.status === "running" ? <Pause /> : <Play />}
        </IconButton>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### <TaskList />

Dense table of agent tasks: status, agent, progress, schedule.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tasks` **(required)** | `AgentTask[]` | — |  |
| `onOpen` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `selectedId` | `string` | — |  |
| `renderActions` | `((task: AgentTask) => ReactNode)` | — | Row actions, e.g. run / pause / menu. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <TaskStatusBadge />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` **(required)** | `"running" \| "failed" \| "draft" \| "queued" \| "needs-input" \| "done" \| "scheduled"` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# TaskPlan

> Category: Workflows · Package: `kestro-ui`

Vertical timeline of an agent's plan with live step states and rich step content (e.g. approvals).

## Import

```tsx
import { TaskPlan } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: task-plan

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button, TaskPlan, type PlanStep } from "kestro-ui";
import { Play, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

const initialSteps: PlanStep[] = [
  { id: "dates", title: "Poll the team for dates", status: "pending" },
  { id: "venue", title: "Shortlist venues near Lisbon", status: "pending" },
  {
    id: "budget",
    title: "Check budget with finance",
    status: "pending",
    details: "€18,400 approved for 24 people · flights, 3 nights, catering and one group activity.",
  },
  { id: "book", title: "Book flights and hotel", status: "pending" },
  { id: "invite", title: "Send calendar invites", status: "pending" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState(initialSteps);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);

  const finished = steps.every((s) => s.status === "complete");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (finished) setRunning(false);
  }, [finished]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setSteps((prev) => {
        const i = prev.findIndex((s) => s.status !== "complete");
        return prev.map((s, idx) => {
          if (idx !== i) return s;
          if (s.status === "pending") return { ...s, status: "running" };
          return { ...s, status: "complete", duration: 2 + idx * 3 };
        });
      });
    }, 900);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [running]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md space-y-5 rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-5">
      <TaskPlan title="Plan a team offsite" steps={steps} />
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button size="sm" variant="accent" onClick={() => setRunning(true)} disabled={running || finished}>
          <Play /> Run
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => {
            setRunning(false);
            setSteps(initialSteps);
          }}
        >
          <RotateCcw /> Reset
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <TaskPlan />

Vertical timeline of an agent's plan / workflow steps.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` **(required)** | `PlanStep[]` | — |  |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `showProgress` | `false \| true` | `true` | Show "3 of 6" + progress bar in the header. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# RunCard

> Category: Workflows · Package: `kestro-ui`

One agent run at a glance: title, run id, status chip and a step timeline that can hold tool calls and approvals.

## Import

```tsx

```

## Example: run-card

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { RunCard, ToolApproval, ToolCall } from "kestro-ui";
import { Mail } from "lucide-react";

export default function Example() {
  const [decision, setDecision] = useState<"pending" | "approved" | "denied">("pending");

  return (
    <RunCard
      className="max-w-xl"
      title="Weekly investor update"
      runId="Run 0388"
      status={decision === "pending" ? "waiting" : decision === "approved" ? "complete" : "failed"}
      steps={[
        { id: "1", title: "Pull this week's metrics", description: "Revenue, churn and pipeline from 3 sources.", status: "complete", duration: 6 },
        {
          id: "2",
          title: "Draft the email",
          status: "complete",
          duration: 11,
          content: <ToolCall name="docs.write" status="success" durationMs={2140} input={{ template: "investor-update", words: 280 }} />,
        },
        {
          id: "3",
          title: decision === "approved" ? "Sent" : "Send to 14 investors",
          status: decision === "pending" ? "waiting" : decision === "approved" ? "complete" : "error",
          content: (
            <ToolApproval
              title="Send this update to 14 investors?"
              icon={<Mail />}
              rememberLabel={false}
              status={decision}
              onApprove={() => setDecision("approved")}
              onDeny={() => setDecision("denied")}
            />
          ),
        },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### <RunCard />

A single agent run: title, run id, status chip and a step timeline with rich step content.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `runId` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `status` | `"waiting" \| "running" \| "complete" \| "failed" \| "paused"` | `"running"` |  |
| `steps` **(required)** | `RunStep[]` | — |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | — | Header actions. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# ActivityFeed

> Category: Workflows · Package: `kestro-ui`

Chronological log of what the agent did.

## Import

```tsx
import { ActivityFeed } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: activity-feed

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { ActivityFeed, Button, type ActivityItem } from "kestro-ui";
import { CalendarCheck, CreditCard, Mail, Package, Plus, TriangleAlert, Truck } from "lucide-react";

const initial: ActivityItem[] = [
  { id: "1", title: "Order #4821 shipped", description: "UPS · arriving Thursday", icon: <Truck />, tone: "success", time: "09:12" },
  { id: "2", title: "Refund issued to Maya Chen", description: "$42.00 to Visa •• 4242", icon: <CreditCard />, tone: "accent", time: "09:05" },
  { id: "3", title: "Low stock: Trail Runner 2, size 9", description: "3 units left in Denver warehouse", icon: <TriangleAlert />, tone: "warning", time: "08:47" },
  { id: "4", title: "Weekly digest sent", description: "1,284 subscribers", icon: <Mail />, time: "08:30" },
];

const extras: Omit<ActivityItem, "id" | "time">[] = [
  { title: "Restock order placed", description: "120 units from supplier", icon: <Package />, tone: "accent" },
  { title: "Demo call booked", description: "Acme Corp · Friday 2:00 PM", icon: <CalendarCheck />, tone: "success" },
  { title: "Payment failed", description: "Card declined for order #4830", icon: <CreditCard />, tone: "danger" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);

  const addItem = () => {
    const next = extras[items.length % extras.length];
    const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false });
    setItems((prev) => [{ ...next, id: String(Date.now()), time }, ...prev]);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface px-4 py-3">
      <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-kui-fg">Store agent activity</h3>
        <Button size="xs" variant="outline" onClick={addItem}>
          <Plus /> Add event
        </Button>
      </div>
      <ActivityFeed items={items.slice(0, 6)} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <ActivityFeed />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` **(required)** | `ActivityItem[]` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# Artifact

> Category: Workflows · Package: `kestro-ui`

Panel for generated documents, code, itineraries or reports with tabs, copy and download.

## Import

```tsx
import { Artifact } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: artifact

```tsx
import { Artifact, CodeBlock, Markdown } from "kestro-ui";
import { Code, Eye, MapPin } from "lucide-react";

const itinerary = `# Kyoto in 3 days

**Travelers:** 2 adults · **Dates:** Apr 4 – Apr 7 · **Budget:** ¥180,000

## Day 1 — Higashiyama
- 08:00 Fushimi Inari before the crowds
- 12:30 Lunch at *Nishiki Market*
- 16:00 Kiyomizu-dera at golden hour

## Day 2 — Arashiyama
- Bamboo grove walk and Tenryū-ji gardens
- Sagano scenic railway (seats reserved, car 5)

## Day 3 — Slow morning
1. Tea ceremony in Gion (10:00, confirmed)
2. Shinkansen to Tokyo at 15:12

> Tip: pick up an ICOCA card at Kyoto Station on arrival.
`;

export default function Example() {
  const download = () => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([itinerary], { type: "text/markdown" }));
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "kyoto-itinerary.md";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <Artifact
      className="h-[460px] max-w-xl"
      icon={<MapPin />}
      title="Kyoto itinerary"
      subtitle="Generated by Atlas · 3 days, 9 stops"
      copyText={itinerary}
      onDownload={download}
      tabs={[
        {
          id: "preview",
          label: "Preview",
          icon: <Eye />,
          content: <Markdown className="px-5 py-4">{itinerary}</Markdown>,
        },
        {
          id: "source",
          label: "Source",
          icon: <Code />,
          content: <CodeBlock code={itinerary} language="markdown" filename="kyoto-itinerary.md" className="m-4" />,
        },
      ]}
      footer="Last updated 2 minutes ago · v3"
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### <Artifact />

Side panel / card for generated documents, code, charts, itineraries, etc.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `subtitle` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `tabs` | `ArtifactTab[]` | — |  |
| `defaultTab` | `string` | — |  |
| `copyText` | `string` | — | Text for the built-in copy button. |
| `onDownload` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `onClose` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Body when not using tabs. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# ConversationList

> Category: Workflows · Package: `kestro-ui`

Sidebar of threads grouped by date, with search, new chat, running and unread states.

## Import

```tsx
import { ConversationList } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: conversation-list

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { ConversationList, type ConversationItem } from "kestro-ui";
import { ChartLine, Coffee, Headset, Plane, ShoppingCart } from "lucide-react";

const initial: ConversationItem[] = [
  { id: "1", group: "Today", title: "Lisbon offsite logistics", icon: <Plane />, running: true },
  { id: "2", group: "Today", title: "Q3 churn analysis", icon: <ChartLine />, unread: true },
  { id: "3", group: "Today", title: "Refund for order #4821", icon: <Headset /> },
  { id: "4", group: "Yesterday", title: "Gift ideas under $50", icon: <ShoppingCart /> },
  { id: "5", group: "Yesterday", title: "Best espresso grinders 2026", icon: <Coffee />, unread: true },
  { id: "6", group: "Yesterday", title: "Draft investor update" },
  { id: "7", group: "Previous 7 days", title: "Summarize onboarding calls" },
  { id: "8", group: "Previous 7 days", title: "Compare CRM pricing" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState("2");

  return (
    <div className="h-[440px] w-72 overflow-hidden rounded-kui border border-kui-border">
      <ConversationList
        items={items}
        activeId={activeId}
        onSelect={(id) => {
          setActiveId(id);
          setItems((prev) => prev.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, unread: false } : i)));
        }}
        onNew={() => {
          const id = String(Date.now());
          setItems((prev) => [{ id, group: "Today", title: "New conversation" }, ...prev]);
          setActiveId(id);
        }}
        onDelete={(id) => setItems((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.id !== id))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <ConversationList />

Sidebar with threads grouped by date, search and "New chat".

| `onNew` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `onDelete` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `newLabel` | `ReactNode` | `"New chat"` |  |
| `searchable` | `false \| true` | `true` |  |
| `header` | `ReactNode` | — |  |

# AgentGraph

> Category: Multi-agent · Package: `kestro-ui`

Animated tree of agents: who delegated to whom, who is working, and where work is flowing. Lays itself out and scales to fit.

## Import

```tsx
import { AgentGraph } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: agent-graph

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AgentGraph, Button, type AgentNode, type AgentNodeState } from "kestro-ui";

const team = [
  { id: "lead", name: "Concierge", role: "Lead" },
  { id: "flights", name: "Flights", role: "Search", parentId: "lead" },
  { id: "hotels", name: "Hotels", role: "Search", parentId: "lead" },
  { id: "reviews", name: "Reviews", role: "Read", parentId: "hotels" },
  { id: "pay", name: "Payments", role: "Checkout", parentId: "lead" },
];

// Which agents are working at each step of the run
const steps: Record<string, AgentNodeState>[] = [
  { lead: "working", flights: "queued", hotels: "queued", reviews: "queued", pay: "queued" },
  { lead: "working", flights: "working", hotels: "working", reviews: "queued", pay: "queued" },
  { lead: "working", flights: "done", hotels: "working", reviews: "working", pay: "queued" },
  { lead: "working", flights: "done", hotels: "done", reviews: "done", pay: "waiting" },
  { lead: "done", flights: "done", hotels: "done", reviews: "done", pay: "done" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => setStep((s) => (s + 1) % steps.length), 2200);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  const nodes: AgentNode[] = team.map((a) => ({
    ...a,
    state: steps[step][a.id],
    activity: steps[step][a.id] === "waiting" ? "Approve £412 checkout" : undefined,
  }));

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl space-y-4">
      <AgentGraph nodes={nodes} />
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setStep((s) => (s + 1) % steps.length)}>
        Next step ({step + 1}/{steps.length})
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <AgentGraph />

Animated tree of agents: who delegated to whom, who's working, and where work is flowing.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` **(required)** | `AgentNode[]` | — |  |
| `links` | `AgentLink[]` | `[]` | Extra peer-to-peer links (drawn dashed), in addition to the parent tree. |
| `direction` | `"down" \| "right"` | `"right"` | Layout direction. Default "right". |
| `nodeWidth` | `number` | `216` |  |
| `nodeHeight` | `number` | `66` |  |
| `levelGap` | `number` | `64` | Space between depth levels. |
| `siblingGap` | `number` | `16` | Space between siblings. |
| `selectedId` | `string` | — |  |
| `onSelect` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# AgentHub

> Category: Multi-agent · Package: `kestro-ui`

Hub-and-spoke view of an orchestrator reaching out to the agents it coordinates, with swaying connections and live work packets.

## Import

```tsx
import { AgentHub } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: agent-hub

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AgentHub, type AgentNodeState } from "kestro-ui";

const agents = [
  { id: "inbox", name: "Inbox", activity: "Triaging 48 emails" },
  { id: "calendar", name: "Calendar", activity: "Finding a slot" },
  { id: "docs", name: "Docs", activity: "Summarizing Q3 notes" },
  { id: "crm", name: "CRM", activity: "Updating 12 contacts" },
  { id: "billing", name: "Billing", activity: "Matching invoices" },
  { id: "travel", name: "Travel", activity: "Rebooking a flight" },
];

const cycle: AgentNodeState[] = ["queued", "working", "working", "done"];

export default function Example() {
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => setTick((t) => t + 1), 1600);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  return (
    <AgentHub
      size={520}
      hub={{ id: "chief", name: "Chief of staff", state: "working", activity: "Coordinating 6 agents" }}
      agents={agents.map((a, i) => ({ ...a, state: cycle[(tick + i) % cycle.length] }))}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### <AgentHub />

Hub-and-spoke ("octopus") view: an orchestrator reaching out to the agents it coordinates.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hub` **(required)** | `Omit<AgentNode, "parentId">` | — | The orchestrating agent in the center. |
| `agents` **(required)** | `Omit<AgentNode, "parentId">[]` | — | Agents (or tools) the hub reaches out to. |
| `size` | `number` | `560` | Square size in px (scales down to fit). Default 560. |
| `sway` | `false \| true` | `true` | Gently sway the tentacles. Default true. |
| `selectedId` | `string` | — |  |
| `onSelect` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# TraceTree

> Category: Multi-agent · Package: `kestro-ui`

Nested trace of agent, LLM, tool and retrieval spans with a live waterfall timeline. Running spans grow in real time.

## Import

```tsx
import { TraceTree } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: trace-tree

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button, TraceTree, type TraceSpan } from "kestro-ui";

const trace: TraceSpan[] = [
  { id: "run", name: "Support agent", kind: "agent", start: 0, end: 6400 },
  { id: "guard", parentId: "run", name: "PII check", kind: "guardrail", start: 80, end: 420 },
  { id: "plan", parentId: "run", name: "Understand the request", kind: "llm", start: 450, end: 1700, meta: "640 tok" },
  { id: "kb", parentId: "run", name: "help_center.search", kind: "retrieval", start: 1750, end: 2900, meta: "5 docs" },
  { id: "order", parentId: "run", name: "orders.lookup #4821", kind: "tool", start: 1800, end: 2600 },
  { id: "refund", parentId: "run", name: "Refund specialist", kind: "handoff", start: 3000, end: 5400 },
  { id: "policy", parentId: "refund", name: "Check refund policy", kind: "llm", start: 3100, end: 4300, meta: "1.1k tok" },
  { id: "issue", parentId: "refund", name: "payments.refund $249", kind: "tool", start: 4400, end: 5300 },
  { id: "reply", parentId: "run", name: "Write the reply", kind: "llm", start: 5450, end: 6400, meta: "380 tok" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (now >= 6400) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => setNow((n) => Math.min(6400, n + 100)), 60);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [now]);

  // Only show spans that have started; unfinished ones render as live bars.
  const spans = trace
    .filter((s) => s.start <= now)
    .map((s) => ({ ...s, end: s.end !== undefined && s.end <= now ? s.end : undefined }));

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl space-y-3">
      <TraceTree spans={spans} now={now} />
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setNow(0)}>
        Replay trace
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <TraceTree />

Nested trace of agent, LLM and tool spans with a live waterfall timeline.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spans` **(required)** | `TraceSpan[]` | — |  |
| `now` | `number` | — | Current time (ms from trace start) for running spans. Auto-advances when omitted. |
| `selectedId` | `string` | — |  |
| `onSelect` | `((id: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# AgentAvatar

> Category: Multi-agent · Package: `kestro-ui`

Avatar with live status (online, working, waiting, error, offline) and gradient agent tile.

## Import

```tsx

```

## Example: agent-avatar

```tsx
import { AgentAvatar, type AgentState } from "kestro-ui";
import { Bot, Headset, Plane } from "lucide-react";

const states: AgentState[] = ["idle", "online", "thinking", "working", "waiting", "error", "offline"];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-xl flex-col gap-8">
      <div className="flex items-end gap-4">
        <AgentAvatar size="xs" name="Atlas" />
        <AgentAvatar size="sm" name="Atlas" />
        <AgentAvatar size="md" name="Atlas" />
        <AgentAvatar size="lg" name="Atlas" />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-5">
        {states.map((state) => (
          <div key={state} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
            <AgentAvatar size="md" name="Atlas" state={state} />

          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <AgentAvatar size="md" variant="user" name="Maya Chen" state="online" />
        <AgentAvatar size="md" variant="user" name="Diego Ramírez" />
        <AgentAvatar size="md" name="Travel" icon={<Plane />} state="working" />
        <AgentAvatar size="md" name="Support" icon={<Headset />} state="waiting" />
        <AgentAvatar size="md" name="Ops" icon={<Bot />} />
        <AgentAvatar size="md" name="Research Lab" initials />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <AgentAvatar />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | — | Used for initials & accessible label. |
| `src` | `string` | — |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom icon; defaults to a sparkle (gradient) or a monogram of `name` (monogram). |
| `initials` | `false \| true` | — | Show initials instead of the icon (e.g. for human users). |
| `state` | `"idle" \| "online" \| "thinking" \| "working" \| "waiting" \| "error" \| "offline"` | — |  |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"sm"` |  |
| `variant` | `"agent" \| "user"` | `"agent"` | "agent" renders the accent gradient, "user" a neutral tile. |
| `appearance` | `"gradient" \| "monogram"` | `"gradient"` | Agent tile style. "gradient" (default) is the accent gradient tile; "monogram" is a flat letter tile tinted by `color`. |
| `color` | `"accent" \| "auto" \| "ink" \| (string & {})` | `"auto"` | Monogram tile color: a CSS color, "accent", "ink", or "auto" (a muted color picked from the name so each agent is recognisable). Default "auto". |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# AgentRoster

> Category: Multi-agent · Package: `kestro-ui`

A team of agents with roles, states and what each one is doing right now.

## Import

```tsx
import { AgentRoster } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: agent-roster

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { AgentRoster, type RosterAgent } from "kestro-ui";
import { CalendarCheck, Compass, CreditCard, Hotel, Plane } from "lucide-react";

const agents: RosterAgent[] = [
  { id: "planner", name: "Planner", role: "Orchestrator", state: "online", activity: "Coordinating 4 agents", avatar: { icon: <Compass /> } },
  { id: "flights", name: "Flights", role: "Search", state: "working", activity: "Comparing 38 fares to Lisbon…", avatar: { icon: <Plane /> } },
  { id: "hotels", name: "Hotels", role: "Search", state: "thinking", activity: "Ranking hotels near Alfama…", avatar: { icon: <Hotel /> } },
  { id: "booker", name: "Booker", role: "Payments", state: "waiting", activity: "Needs approval for €2,140", avatar: { icon: <CreditCard /> } },
  { id: "calendar", name: "Calendar", role: "Scheduling", state: "idle", avatar: { icon: <CalendarCheck /> } },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState("planner");
  const active = agents.find((a) => a.id === activeId);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-2">
      <p className="px-2 pt-1 pb-2 text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wide text-kui-fg-subtle uppercase">Trip team</p>
      <AgentRoster agents={agents} activeId={activeId} onSelect={setActiveId} />
      <p className="mt-2 border-t border-kui-border px-2 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-xs text-kui-fg-muted">
        Viewing <span className="font-medium text-kui-fg">{active?.name}</span>'s workspace
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# AgentHandoff

> Category: Multi-agent · Package: `kestro-ui`

```tsx
import { AgentHandoff, Message } from "kestro-ui";

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-xl flex-col gap-5">
```
