      </Message>

      <AgentHandoff from={planner} to={hotels} reason="hotel search" />

      <Message from="assistant" name={hotels.name} avatar={hotels.avatar}>
        Top pick: Memmo Alfama — rooftop pool, river views, €232/night. Two backups are within budget too.
      </Message>
      <Message from="user">Memmo looks great, go ahead.</Message>

      <AgentHandoff from={hotels} to={booker} reason="payment" />

      <Message from="assistant" name={booker.name} avatar={booker.avatar}>
        Booked! 3 nights at Memmo Alfama, €696 total. Confirmation #MA-55821 is in your inbox.
      </Message>

  );
}

# ImageGallery

> Category: Images · Package: `kestro-ui`

Grid for one or many images in a message, with a shared lightbox and an optional 'Ask about this image' action that references the image in the composer.

## Import

```tsx
import { ImageGallery } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: image-gallery

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { ImageGallery, Message, type ImageItem } from "kestro-ui";

const photos: ImageItem[] = [
  { src: "images/rooftops.svg", alt: "Alfama rooftops at sunset", caption: "Option 1 · Casa do Largo terrace, Alfama" },
  { src: "images/coast.svg", alt: "Cliffs above the Atlantic", caption: "Option 2 · Cascais, 40 min by train" },
  { src: "images/forest.svg", alt: "Pine forest in Sintra", caption: "Option 3 · Sintra hills retreat" },
  { src: "images/night.svg", alt: "Baixa at night", caption: "Option 4 · Baixa, walkable to everything" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [asked, setAsked] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-4">
      <Message from="assistant" name="Atlas" avatar={{ appearance: "monogram", color: "accent", name: "Atlas" }}>
        <p className="text-[15px]">Here are four venues that fit 12 people. Click any photo to zoom in.</p>
        <ImageGallery images={photos} max={3} onReference={(img) => setAsked(img.alt ?? "image")} />
      </Message>
      {asked ? <p className="text-sm text-kui-fg-muted">Referenced in the composer: “{asked}”</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# Lightbox

> Category: Images · Package: `kestro-ui`

Full-screen image viewer: zoom with wheel, pinch, double-click or buttons, drag to pan, arrow keys to browse, captions and download. ImagePreview opens it from a single thumbnail.

## Import

```tsx
import { Lightbox, ImagePreview } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: lightbox

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, ImagePreview, Lightbox } from "kestro-ui";
import { Maximize2 } from "lucide-react";

const images = [
  { src: "images/coast.svg", alt: "Generated: cliffs above the Atlantic", caption: "Generated in 4.2s · 1024×768" },
  { src: "images/night.svg", alt: "Generated: city skyline at night", caption: "Variation 2 · warmer windows" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
      {/* Single image: click to open, wheel / pinch / double-click to zoom */}
      <ImagePreview image={images[0]} aspect="4/3" />

      {/* Or control the lightbox yourself */}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-start justify-center gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm text-kui-fg-muted">Keyboard: ← → to browse, + − 0 to zoom, Esc to close.</p>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => {
            setIndex(0);
            setOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          <Maximize2 /> Open both images
        </Button>
      </div>
      <Lightbox images={images} index={index} onIndexChange={setIndex} open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Lightbox />

Full-screen image viewer with zoom (wheel, pinch, double-click, buttons), pan and keyboard navigation.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `images` **(required)** | `ImageItem[]` | — |  |
| `index` **(required)** | `number` | — | Index of the image to show. |
| `open` **(required)** | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `onOpenChange` **(required)** | `(open: boolean) => void` | — |  |
| `onIndexChange` | `((index: number) => void)` | — |  |
| `onReference` | `((image: ImageItem, index: number) => void)` | — | Adds an "Ask about this image" action — e.g. to reference it in the chat composer. |
| `referenceLabel` | `string` | `"Ask about this image"` |  |
| `download` | `false \| true` | `true` | Show a download button. Default true. |

### <ImagePreview />

A single image with loading state that opens a zoomable lightbox.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` **(required)** | `ImageItem` | — |  |
| `zoomable` | `false \| true` | `true` | Click opens a lightbox. Default true. |
| `onReference` | `((image: ImageItem, index: number) => void)` | — |  |
| `aspect` | `string` | — | CSS aspect ratio, e.g. "16/9". Uses the image's own when omitted. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# VoicePanel

> Category: Voice · Package: `kestro-ui`

A full voice-call surface with animated orb, status, transcript and call controls. Includes VoiceOrb and VoiceWave.

## Import

```tsx
import { VoicePanel, VoiceOrb, VoiceWave } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: voice-panel

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button, VoiceOrb, VoicePanel, VoiceWave, type VoiceState } from "kestro-ui";
import { Phone } from "lucide-react";

const script: { state: VoiceState; ms: number; text?: string }[] = [
  { state: "connecting", ms: 1400 },
  { state: "speaking", ms: 3800, text: "Hi Sam, it's Ava from Northwind Dental — calling to confirm your cleaning tomorrow at 10 AM." },
  { state: "listening", ms: 3000, text: "Could we move it to the afternoon instead?" },
  { state: "thinking", ms: 1400 },
  { state: "speaking", ms: 3800, text: "Of course. I have 2:30 or 4:15 open — which works better for you?" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [inCall, setInCall] = useState(true);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const { state, ms, text } = script[step];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inCall) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => setStep((s) => (s + 1 < script.length ? s + 1 : 2)), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [inCall, step, ms]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inCall) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => setElapsed((e) => e + 1), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [inCall]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audible = state === "speaking" || (state === "listening" && !muted);
    if (!inCall || !audible) {
      setLevel(0);
      return;
    }
    let raf = 0;
    const loop = (now: number) => {
      const t = now / 1000;
      setLevel(0.25 + Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 5.2)) * 0.5 + Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.15);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [inCall, state, muted]);

  const start = () => {
    setStep(0);
    setElapsed(0);
    setInCall(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-xl flex-col items-center gap-6">
      <div className="w-full rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface">
        {inCall ? (
          <VoicePanel
            name="Ava · Northwind Dental"
            state={state}
            level={level}
            transcript={text}
            elapsed={state === "connecting" ? undefined : elapsed}
            muted={muted}
            onToggleMute={() => setMuted((m) => !m)}
            onEnd={() => setInCall(false)}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 py-16 text-sm text-kui-fg-muted">
            Call ended · {Math.floor(elapsed / 60)}:{String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, "0")}
            <Button variant="accent" onClick={start}>
              <Phone /> Call again
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
        {(["idle", "connecting", "listening", "thinking", "speaking"] as const).map((s) => (
          <VoiceOrb key={s} state={s} level={0.6} size={44} />
        ))}
        <VoiceWave />
        <VoiceWave bars={7} active={false} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <VoicePanel />

A complete voice-call surface: orb, status, transcript and call controls.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` **(required)** | `"idle" \| "thinking" \| "connecting" \| "listening" \| "speaking"` | — |  |
| `level` | `number` | — |  |
| `name` | `ReactNode` | — | Agent name shown above the status. |
| `transcript` | `ReactNode` | — | Live transcript line (what the user or agent is saying). |
| `muted` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `onToggleMute` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `onEnd` | `(() => void)` | — |  |
| `elapsed` | `number` | — | Call duration in seconds. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <VoiceOrb />

Animated orb that visualizes a voice agent's state.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"idle" \| "thinking" \| "connecting" \| "listening" \| "speaking"` | `"idle"` |  |
| `level` | `number` | `0` | Live audio amplitude 0–1 (mic level while listening, output level while speaking). |
| `size` | `number` | `168` | Diameter in px. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <VoiceWave />

Small animated equalizer bars — use for "speaking" indicators.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bars` | `number` | `5` |  |
| `active` | `false \| true` | `true` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# AgentCore

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Arc-reactor style presence for an AI agent. Reacts to state, live loudness and a real audio spectrum from the microphone or TTS output.

## Import

```tsx
import { AgentCore } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: agent-core

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AgentCore, Button, HudBackground, useAudioAnalyser, useMicrophone, type CoreState } from "kestro-ui";
import { Mic, MicOff } from "lucide-react";

const states: CoreState[] = ["idle", "listening", "thinking", "speaking", "working", "error", "offline"];

export default function Example() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CoreState>("speaking");
  const [simLevel, setSimLevel] = useState(0);
  const mic = useMicrophone();
  const { level: micLevel, spectrum } = useAudioAnalyser(mic.stream);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mic.active || (state !== "speaking" && state !== "listening")) return;
    let raf = 0;
    const loop = (now: number) => {
      const t = now / 1000;
      setSimLevel(0.35 + Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 4.3)) * 0.4 + Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.15);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [state, mic.active]);

  const current = mic.active ? "listening" : state;

  return (
    <div
      data-kui-theme="dark"
      className="relative flex w-full max-w-2xl flex-col items-center gap-6 overflow-hidden rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-bg px-6 py-10 text-kui-fg"
    >
      <HudBackground />
      <AgentCore
        state={current}
        level={mic.active ? micLevel : simLevel}
        spectrum={mic.active ? spectrum : undefined}
        size={280}
        label="Nova"
        sublabel={mic.active ? "Mic live" : current}
      />
      <div className="relative flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-1.5">
        {states.map((s) => (
          <Button
            key={s}
            size="xs"
            variant={current === s ? "accent" : "outline"}
            disabled={mic.active}
            onClick={() => setState(s)}
            className="capitalize"
          >
            {s}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
        <Button variant={mic.active ? "danger" : "secondary"} onClick={mic.active ? mic.stop : mic.start}>
          {mic.active ? <MicOff /> : <Mic />}
          {mic.active ? "Stop microphone" : "Use microphone"}
        </Button>
        {mic.error ? <p className="text-xs text-kui-danger">{mic.error}</p> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <AgentCore />

Arc-reactor style "presence" for an AI agent — reacts to state and audio.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"idle" \| "thinking" \| "working" \| "error" \| "offline" \| "listening" \| "speaking"` | `"idle"` |  |
| `level` | `number` | `0` | Live loudness 0–1. |
| `spectrum` | `number[]` | — | Optional frequency bins 0–1 (from useAudioAnalyser). Synthesized from `level` when omitted. |
| `size` | `number` | `300` | Diameter in px. Default 300. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Center content (e.g. agent name). |
| `sublabel` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# AttitudeIndicator

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

An aviation attitude indicator as agent presence: the horizon steadies when idle, rolls while thinking and responds to audio. The bezel pointer shows any 0–100 value.

## Import

```tsx
import { AttitudeIndicator } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: attitude-indicator

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AttitudeIndicator, Button, type CoreState } from "kestro-ui";

const states: { state: CoreState; label: string; value: number }[] = [
  { state: "idle", label: "Standing by", value: 10 },
  { state: "thinking", label: "Planning", value: 45 },
  { state: "speaking", label: "Speaking", value: 70 },
  { state: "error", label: "Tool failed", value: 45 },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [i, setI] = useState(1);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  const { state, label, value } = states[i];

  // Fake audio level while speaking
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state !== "speaking") return;
    const id = setInterval(() => setLevel(0.3 + Math.random() * 0.6), 120);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [state]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5">
      <AttitudeIndicator state={state} level={level} value={value} label={label} sublabel="Concierge / A-01" size={360} />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
        {states.map((s, j) => (
          <Button key={s.state} size="sm" variant={i === j ? "primary" : "outline"} onClick={() => setI(j)}>
            {s.state}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <AttitudeIndicator />

An aviation attitude indicator re-imagined as an agent's presence:
the horizon steadies when idle, rolls gently while thinking, and responds
to audio while listening or speaking. The bezel pointer shows `value`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"idle" \| "thinking" \| "working" \| "error" \| "offline" \| "listening" \| "speaking"` | `"idle"` |  |
| `value` | `number` | — | Bezel pointer 0–100 (e.g. confidence, progress, context used). |
| `level` | `number` | `0` | Live loudness 0–1 — tilts the horizon while listening/speaking. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Large label drawn in the sky (e.g. "Awaiting approval"). |
| `sublabel` | `ReactNode` | — | Small caption under the label (e.g. "Executor / K-03"). |
| `caption` | `ReactNode` | — | Third line, e.g. "Observe → Propose → Confirm". |
| `tone` | `"accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted"` | `"warning"` | Instrument markings color. Default "warning" (ochre). |
| `size` | `number` | `420` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# HudPanel

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Sci-fi framed panel with corner brackets, scanlines and glow, plus an ambient HudBackground grid.

## Import

```tsx
import { HudPanel, HudBackground } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: hud-panel

```tsx
import { Badge, HudBackground, HudPanel, Sparkline } from "kestro-ui";

const telemetry = [
  { label: "Uplink", value: "Stable", tone: "text-kui-success" },
  { label: "Latency", value: "38 ms", tone: "text-kui-fg" },
  { label: "Active tasks", value: "7", tone: "text-kui-fg" },
  { label: "Anomalies", value: "1", tone: "text-kui-warning" },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div data-kui-theme="dark" className="relative flex w-full max-w-2xl justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-kui bg-kui-bg p-10 text-kui-fg">
      <HudBackground />
      <HudPanel
        className="w-full max-w-sm"
        title="Systems overview"
        code="SYS-01"
        status={
          <Badge tone="success" dot pulse>
            Nominal
          </Badge>
        }
        scanlines
        glow
      >
        <dl className="divide-y divide-kui-accent/10 font-mono text-xs">
          {telemetry.map((row) => (
            <div key={row.label} className="flex justify-between py-2">
              <dt className="tracking-wider text-kui-fg-subtle uppercase">{row.label}</dt>
              <dd className={row.tone}>{row.value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px] tracking-[0.18em] text-kui-fg-subtle uppercase">Throughput · 1h</span>
          <Sparkline data={[12, 18, 15, 22, 28, 24, 31, 27, 35, 33, 41]} width={140} live />
        </div>
      </HudPanel>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <HudPanel />

Sci-fi framed panel with corner brackets — the building block of HUD layouts.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `code` | `ReactNode` | — | Small code shown on the right of the header, e.g. "SYS-01". |
| `status` | `ReactNode` | — | Right-side header slot (status, actions). |
| `scanlines` | `false \| true` | — | Subtle CRT scanlines + moving scan bar. |
| `glow` | `false \| true` | — | Accent glow around the border. |
| `bodyClassName` | `string` | — |  |

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

### <HudBackground />

Ambient grid + glow + optional sweeping scan line. Place inside a `relative` container.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scan` | `false \| true` | `true` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# RadialGauge

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Animated 270° gauge for telemetry like confidence, CPU or context window.

## Import

```tsx
import { RadialGauge } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: radial-gauge

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { RadialGauge } from "kestro-ui";

const jitter = (v: number, spread: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v + (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread));

export default function Example() {
  const [cpu, setCpu] = useState(42);
  const [confidence, setConfidence] = useState(0.91);
  const [context, setContext] = useState(64_000);
  const [load, setLoad] = useState(58);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setCpu((v) => jitter(v, 30, 5, 98));
      setConfidence((v) => jitter(v, 0.12, 0.55, 0.99));
      setContext((v) => jitter(v, 30_000, 10_000, 195_000));
      setLoad((v) => jitter(v, 40, 10, 99));
    }, 1500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-2xl flex-wrap justify-center gap-8">
      <RadialGauge label="CPU" value={cpu} unit="%" />
      <RadialGauge label="Confidence" value={confidence} max={1} tone="info" format={(v) => v.toFixed(2)} />
      <RadialGauge label="Context" value={context} max={200_000} tone="warning" format={(v) => `${Math.round(v / 1000)}k`} />
      <RadialGauge label="Queue load" value={load} unit="%" tone="auto" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <RadialGauge />

270° arc gauge for telemetry: CPU, confidence, context window, latency…

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` **(required)** | `number` | — |  |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `unit` | `string` | — |  |
| `size` | `number` | `132` |  |
| `tone` | `"accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "auto"` | `"accent"` | Fixed tone, or thresholds chosen automatically when "auto". |
| `format` | `((value: number) => ReactNode)` | — | Format the center value. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# HudStat

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Telemetry readout with big mono value, delta and live sparkline.

## Import

```tsx
import { HudStat, Sparkline } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: hud-stat

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { HudStat, Sparkline } from "kestro-ui";
import { Activity, Clock, Users, Zap } from "lucide-react";

const seed = (base: number) => Array.from({ length: 20 }, () => base * (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3));
const push = (data: number[], base: number) => [...data.slice(1), base * (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3)];
const last = (data: number[]) => data[data.length - 1];

export default function Example() {
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState(() => seed(1240));
  const [latency, setLatency] = useState(() => seed(320));
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState(() => seed(86));
  const [tokens, setTokens] = useState(() => seed(48));

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setRequests((d) => push(d, 1240));
      setLatency((d) => push(d, 320));
      setSessions((d) => push(d, 86));
      setTokens((d) => push(d, 48));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  const delta = (d: number[]) => ((last(d) - d[0]) / d[0]) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl space-y-6">
      <div className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-6 rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <HudStat label="Requests / min" icon={<Activity />} value={Math.round(last(requests)).toLocaleString()} delta={delta(requests)} data={requests} />
        <HudStat label="p95 latency" icon={<Clock />} value={Math.round(last(latency))} unit="ms" delta={delta(latency)} invertDelta data={latency} />
        <HudStat label="Live sessions" icon={<Users />} value={Math.round(last(sessions))} delta={delta(sessions)} data={sessions} />
        <HudStat label="Tokens / sec" icon={<Zap />} value={last(tokens).toFixed(1)} unit="k" delta={delta(tokens)} data={tokens} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-kui-fg-muted">
        Standalone sparklines
        <Sparkline data={requests} />
        <Sparkline data={latency} tone="warning" fill={false} />
        <Sparkline data={sessions} tone="success" live />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <HudStat />

Telemetry readout: label, big mono value, delta and sparkline.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `value` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `unit` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `delta` | `number` | — | Percentage change; positive renders as success. |
| `invertDelta` | `false \| true` | — | Invert delta colors (e.g. latency: lower is better). |
| `data` | `number[]` | — |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <Sparkline />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` **(required)** | `number[]` | — |  |
| `width` | `number` | `120` |  |
| `height` | `number` | `32` |  |
| `tone` | `"accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info"` | `"accent"` |  |
| `fill` | `false \| true` | `true` |  |
| `live` | `false \| true` | `false` | Pulse the last point. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# TelemetryChart

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Big readout plus a gridded line chart for latency, throughput, success rate or cost.

## Import

```tsx
import { TelemetryChart } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: telemetry-chart

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { TelemetryChart } from "kestro-ui";

const seed = (base: number, jitter: number) => Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => base + Math.sin(i / 2) * jitter);

export default function Example() {
  const [latency, setLatency] = useState(() => seed(820, 60));
  const [cost, setCost] = useState(() => seed(0.42, 0.05));

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setLatency((d) => [...d.slice(1), Math.max(600, Math.min(1100, d[d.length - 1] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120))]);
      setCost((d) => [...d.slice(1), Math.max(0.3, Math.min(0.6, d[d.length - 1] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06))]);
    }, 900);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg space-y-6 rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-5">
      <TelemetryChart
        label="Latency"
        value={Math.round(latency[latency.length - 1])}
        unit="ms"
        data={latency}
        min={400}
        max={1200}
        xLabels={["-20m", "-15m", "-10m", "-5m", "now"]}
      />
      <TelemetryChart
        label="Cost / run"
        value={`$${cost[cost.length - 1].toFixed(2)}`}
        data={cost}
        min={0.2}
        max={0.7}
        formatY={(v) => `$${v.toFixed(2)}`}
        tone="info"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <TelemetryChart />

Readout + gridded line chart for latency, throughput, success rate, cost…

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `value` | `ReactNode` | — | Big readout; defaults to the last data point. |
| `unit` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `data` **(required)** | `number[]` | — |  |
| `xLabels` | `string[]` | — | X-axis labels (shown at even intervals). |
| `yTicks` | `number` | `4` | Y-axis tick count. Default 4. |
| `min` | `number` | — |  |
| `max` | `number` | — |  |
| `formatY` | `((v: number) => string)` | `(v) => (Math.abs(v) >= 1000 ? v.toLocaleString() : String(Math.round(v * 10) / 10))` | Format y-axis labels. |
| `tone` | `"accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted"` | `"warning"` |  |
| `height` | `number` | `96` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# Waveform

            type="range"

          <p className="text-xs text-kui-fg-subtle">Inactive (muted)</p>
          <Waveform active={false} bars={32} height={40} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

# CommandConsole

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Terminal-style command line with history, typed streaming output and line kinds.

## Import

```tsx
import { CommandConsole } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: command-console

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CommandConsole, type ConsoleLine, type ConsoleLineKind } from "kestro-ui";

const now = () => new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour12: false });

const responses: Record<string, { kind: ConsoleLineKind; text: string }> = {
  help: { kind: "output", text: "Available commands: status, scan, help, clear" },
  status: { kind: "success", text: "All systems nominal. Power 98% · 3 agents online · 0 alerts in the last hour." },
  scan: { kind: "warning", text: "Perimeter scan complete. 14 devices found — 1 unrecognized device on the guest network." },
};

export default function Example() {
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<ConsoleLine[]>([
    { id: "boot", kind: "system", text: "NOVA online. Type “help” to see what I can do.", time: now() },
  ]);
  const nextId = useRef(0);
  const timers = useRef<number[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => () => timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout), []);

  const run = (command: string) => {
    const key = command.toLowerCase();
    if (key === "clear") {
      setLines([]);
      return;
    }
    const reply = responses[key] ?? {
      kind: "error" as const,
      text: `Unknown command “${command}”. Try “help”.`,
    };
    const id = String(nextId.current++);
    setLines((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { id: `${id}-in`, kind: "input", text: command, time: now() },
      { id, ...reply, time: now(), streaming: true },
    ]);
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setLines((prev) => prev.map((l) => (l.id === id ? { ...l, streaming: false } : l)));
    }, 400 + reply.text.length * 10);
    timers.current.push(timer);
  };

  return <CommandConsole className="w-full max-w-xl" title="Nova · shell" lines={lines} onCommand={run} />;
}
```

## API

### <CommandConsole />

Terminal-style command line for operating an agent by text commands.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lines` **(required)** | `ConsoleLine[]` | — |  |
| `onCommand` | `((command: string) => void)` | — |  |
| `prompt` | `string` | `"›"` |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Type a command…"` |  |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | `"Command"` |  |
| `height` | `string \| number` | `280` | Height of the scroll area. Default 280. |
| `disabled` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# EventLog

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Structured event stream (event name + key=value fields) for agent runs and audit trails.

## Import

```tsx
import { EventLog } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: event-log

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button, EventLog, type LogEvent } from "kestro-ui";

const script: Omit<LogEvent, "id" | "time">[] = [
  { event: "run.started", fields: { agent: "support-02", ticket: 88213 } },
  { event: "orders.lookup complete", fields: { order: "#4821", status: "delivered" } },
  { event: "policy.check complete", fields: { refundable: true, window_days: 30 } },
  { event: "approval.requested", tone: "warning", fields: { action: "refund", amount: "$249.00" } },
];

const stamp = () => new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour12: false });

export default function Example() {
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<LogEvent[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (events.length >= script.length) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => {
      setEvents((list) => [
        ...list.map((e) => ({ ...e, streaming: false })),
        { ...script[list.length], id: String(list.length), time: stamp(), streaming: true },
      ]);
    }, 900);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [events]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg space-y-3">
      <div className="rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface px-4 py-1">
        <EventLog events={events} footer={events.length === script.length ? "Awaiting operator input" : undefined} />
      </div>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setEvents([])}>
        Replay
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <EventLog />

Structured event stream (`event` + `key=value` fields) for agent runs and audits.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` **(required)** | `LogEvent[]` | — |  |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | — | Footer prompt, e.g. "Awaiting operator input". |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# BootSequence

> Category: HUD · Package: `kestro-ui`

Animated startup checklist for 'agent waking up' moments.

## Import

```tsx
import { BootSequence } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: boot-sequence

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { BootSequence, Button } from "kestro-ui";
import { RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

const steps = [
  "Loading voice profile",
  "Connecting to calendar and inbox",
  "Syncing smart-home devices (12)",
  "Restoring memory from last session",
  "Calibrating wake word",
  "Running safety checks",
];

export default function Example() {
  const [run, setRun] = useState(0);
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(false);

  const replay = () => {
    setOnline(false);
    setRun((r) => r + 1);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-5 rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-6">
      <BootSequence key={run} steps={steps} title="Waking up Nova" onComplete={() => setOnline(true)} />
      <div className="flex min-h-8 items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <p className="text-sm text-kui-fg-muted">
          {online ? <span className="text-kui-success">Good morning. All systems are online.</span> : "Booting…"}
        </p>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={replay}>
          <RotateCcw /> Replay
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <BootSequence />

# ChatWidget

> Category: Embed · Package: `kestro-ui`

Floating launcher + chat panel to put an agent on any website.

## Import

```tsx
import { ChatWidget } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: chat-widget

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { AgentChat, ChatWidget, type ChatMessage, type ChatStatus } from "kestro-ui";
import { Package, RotateCcw, Ruler } from "lucide-react";

function reply(text: string) {
  const q = text.toLowerCase();
  if (q.includes("order")) return "Your order **#4821** shipped yesterday with UPS and should arrive **Thursday**. Want the tracking link?";
  if (q.includes("return")) return "Returns are free within **30 days**. I can start a return for you now — which item is it?";
  if (q.includes("size")) return "Our Trail Runner 2 fits true to size. If you're between sizes, go **half a size up**.";
  return "Happy to help! I can track orders, start returns, or help you find the right size.";
}

export default function Example() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ChatStatus>("ready");
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);

  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  const send = (text: string) => {
    const id = String(Date.now());
    setMessages((m) => [...m, { id: `${id}-u`, role: "user", content: text }]);
    setStatus("submitted");
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setMessages((m) => [...m, { id, role: "assistant", content: reply(text) }]);
      setStatus("ready");
    }, 900);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative h-[560px] w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-6 border-b border-kui-border px-6 py-4 text-sm">
        <span className="font-semibold text-kui-fg">Trailhead</span>
        <nav className="flex gap-4 text-kui-fg-muted">
          <span>Shoes</span>
          <span>Apparel</span>
          <span>Sale</span>
        </nav>
      </header>
      <div className="space-y-3 px-6 py-10">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-kui-fg">Built for the long way round.</h1>
        <p className="max-w-sm text-kui-fg-muted">Lightweight trail gear, tested on 4,000 miles of switchbacks.</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-6">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <div key={i} className="h-28 rounded-kui bg-kui-surface-3" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <ChatWidget contained width={340} height={430} title="Trailhead Support" subtitle="AI assistant · replies instantly" greeting="Need help with an order or sizing?">
        <AgentChat
          compact
          messages={messages}
          status={status}
          onSend={send}
          allowAttachments={false}
          agent={{ name: "Trailhead Support", description: "Ask about orders, returns and sizing." }}
          suggestions={[
            { label: "Where's my order?", icon: <Package /> },
            { label: "Start a return", icon: <RotateCcw /> },
            { label: "Size advice", icon: <Ruler /> },
          ]}
        />
      </ChatWidget>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <ChatWidget />

Floating launcher + chat panel for embedding an agent on any website.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `ReactNode` | `"Assistant"` |  |
| `subtitle` | `ReactNode` | `"Typically replies instantly"` |  |
| `avatar` | `AgentAvatarProps` | — |  |
| `open` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `false \| true` | `false` |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `((open: boolean) => void)` | — |  |
| `position` | `"bottom-right" \| "bottom-left"` | `"bottom-right"` |  |
| `greeting` | `ReactNode` | — | Teaser bubble shown next to the launcher while closed. |
| `launcherIcon` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `contained` | `false \| true` | `false` | Render inline (position: absolute within parent) instead of fixed to the viewport. |
| `width` | `number` | `400` |  |
| `height` | `number` | `640` |  |
| `children` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — | Panel body — typically <AgentChat compact /> |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

# Button

> Category: Primitives · Package: `kestro-ui`

Buttons and icon buttons with variants, sizes and loading state.

## Import

```tsx
import { Button, IconButton } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: button

```tsx
import { Button, IconButton } from "kestro-ui";
import { Copy, Mail, Plus, Send, Sparkles, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button>Primary</Button>
        <Button variant="accent">
          <Sparkles /> Ask agent
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary">Secondary</Button>
        <Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
        <Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>
        <Button variant="danger">
          <Trash2 /> Delete
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button size="xs">Extra small</Button>
        <Button size="sm">Small</Button>
        <Button size="md">Medium</Button>
        <Button size="lg">
          <Send /> Large
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button variant="accent" loading>
          Booking…
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" disabled>
          <Mail /> Disabled
        </Button>
        <IconButton label="Copy" size="xs">
          <Copy />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton label="New chat" variant="outline">
          <Plus />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton label="Delete conversation" size="md" variant="secondary">
          <Trash2 />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Button />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"accent" \| "danger" \| "primary" \| "secondary" \| "outline" \| "ghost"` | `"primary"` |  |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "icon" \| "icon-sm" \| "icon-xs"` | `"md"` |  |
| `loading` | `false \| true` | — |  |

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

### <IconButton />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` **(required)** | `string` | — |  |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md"` | `"sm"` |  |
| `tooltip` | `false \| true` | `true` |  |
| `variant` | `"accent" \| "danger" \| "primary" \| "secondary" \| "outline" \| "ghost"` | `"ghost"` |  |
| `loading` | `false \| true` | — |  |

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

# Switch

> Category: Primitives · Package: `kestro-ui`

Switch and SegmentedControl — the toggles used by settings, permissions and task forms.

## Import

```tsx
import { Switch, SegmentedControl } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: controls

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { SegmentedControl, Switch } from "kestro-ui";
import { Bot, Hand, Zap } from "lucide-react";

export default function Example() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState("ask");
  const [voice, setVoice] = useState(true);
  const [memory, setMemory] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-5 rounded-kui border border-kui-border bg-kui-surface p-5">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <p className="text-[13px] font-medium">Autonomy</p>
        <SegmentedControl
          block
          aria-label="Autonomy"
          value={mode}
          onValueChange={setMode}
          options={[
            { value: "manual", label: "Manual", icon: <Hand /> },
            { value: "ask", label: "Ask first", icon: <Bot /> },
            { value: "auto", label: "Auto", icon: <Zap /> },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
      <label className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-[13px]">Voice replies</span>
        <Switch checked={voice} onCheckedChange={setVoice} aria-label="Voice replies" />
      </label>
      <label className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-[13px]">Remember past conversations</span>
        <Switch checked={memory} onCheckedChange={setMemory} aria-label="Remember past conversations" />
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Switch />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `defaultChecked` | `false \| true` | `false` |  |
| `onCheckedChange` | `((checked: boolean) => void)` | — |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` |  |

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

### <SegmentedControl />

A compact single-choice toggle group with a sliding indicator.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` **(required)** | `SegmentOption<T>[]` | — |  |
| `value` | `T` | — |  |
| `defaultValue` | `T` | — |  |
| `onValueChange` | `((value: T) => void)` | — |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` |  |
| `block` | `false \| true` | — | Stretch to the container width. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

---

# Badge

> Category: Primitives · Package: `kestro-ui`

Badges, status dots, spinner, shimmer text, keyboard keys and tooltips.

## Import

```tsx
import { Badge, StatusDot, Spinner, ShimmerText, Kbd, Tooltip } from "kestro-ui";
```

## Example: badge

```tsx
import { Badge, Button, Kbd, ShimmerText, Spinner, StatusDot, Tooltip } from "kestro-ui";
import { Check, Info } from "lucide-react";

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Badge>Neutral</Badge>
        <Badge tone="accent">New</Badge>
        <Badge tone="success">
          <Check /> Delivered
        </Badge>
        <Badge tone="warning" dot>
          Awaiting approval
        </Badge>
        <Badge tone="danger">Payment failed</Badge>
        <Badge tone="info" dot pulse>
          Live
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5 text-sm text-kui-fg-muted">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <StatusDot pulse /> Online
        </span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <StatusDot tone="warning" /> Away
        </span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Spinner /> Loading
        </span>
        <ShimmerText>Searching 48 hotels…</ShimmerText>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sm text-kui-fg-muted">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Kbd>⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd>K</Kbd>
          <span className="ml-1">to open the command menu</span>
        </span>
        <Tooltip content="Prices include taxes and fees">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="xs">
            <Info /> Hover me
          </Button>
        </Tooltip>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### <Badge />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `"neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info"` | `"neutral"` |  |
| `dot` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `pulse` | `false \| true` | — |  |

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

### <StatusDot />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `"neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info"` | `"success"` |  |
| `pulse` | `false \| true` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <Spinner />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <ShimmerText />

Animated gradient text for live "Thinking…" / "Searching…" labels.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `active` | `false \| true` | `true` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <Kbd />

No props.

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

### <Tooltip />

Lightweight CSS-only tooltip (hover & focus).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `children` **(required)** | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `side` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | `"top"` |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

No props.

Also accepts the native HTML attributes of its root element.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <SourceIcon />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` **(required)** | `Source` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### <MessageParts />

Renders every part of a message: text, reasoning, tools, approvals, sources, files.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` **(required)** | `ChatMessage` | — |  |
| `streaming` | `false \| true` | `false` | The message is currently being streamed. |
| `renderTool` | `((part: ToolPart, ctx: { name: string; status: ToolStatus; }) => ReactNode)` | — | Return a node to custom-render a tool (generative UI); return undefined for the default card. |
| `renderData` | `((part: DataPart) => ReactNode)` | — | Render custom `data-*` parts. |
| `onToolApproval` | `((decision: { id: string; approved: boolean; part: ToolPart; }) => void)` | — |  |
| `toolTitles` | `Record<string, string>` | — | Friendly titles per tool name, e.g. { web_search: "Searching the web" } |
| `renderCode` | `((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)` | — |  |
| `onImageReference` | `((image: ImageItem) => void)` | — | Adds "Ask about this image" to the lightbox of image attachments. |
